<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="renderer-consumer-guide">
<h1>Renderer consumer guide</h1>
<p>UtterPlan ends at a semantic planning boundary. A renderer consumes the public <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code> and begins G2P after planning. It does not need a TOML round trip when planner and renderer run in the same process.</p>
<p>The schema-v7 plan is renderer-independent: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowUnit</span></code> grouping is fixed paragraph-local, while <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowSegment</span></code> boundary arrays carry safe cut opportunities. Segments are not necessarily TTS calls, and UtterPlan’s linguistic tokens are not model-token counts. A consumer may choose sentence, paragraph, or engine-token-budget chunks and native, automatic, or manual pause realization without changing the saved plan.</p>
<p>For persistence across processes, save a current plan as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.utterplan.toml</span></code> and load it with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.load()</span></code>. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">to_toml()</span></code> / <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">from_toml()</span></code> provide text round-tripping, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_id</span></code> identifies executable semantics rather than TOML formatting. Batch reports and optional compiler traces are operational/provenance artifacts, not plans.</p>
<p>UtterPlan accepts SSMD source syntax at version 0.9 only. Convert older source with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ssmd</span> <span class="pre">migrate</span> <span class="pre">FILE</span> <span class="pre">--to</span> <span class="pre">0.9</span></code>; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan</span> <span class="pre">migrate</span></code> is for importing serialized legacy plans.</p>
<section id="importing-legacy-plans">
<h2>Importing legacy plans</h2>
<p>Normal loading and execution accept schema v7 only. Historical schemas retain an explicit sequential, serialized-data migration path through v6; v6-to-v7 migration refuses because it cannot reconstruct the complete boundary inventory, so recompile the original source. Normal APIs reject older plans with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">schema.version_unsupported</span></code>. Import explicitly:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>utterplan<span class="w"> </span>migrate<span class="w"> </span>old.utterplan.json<span class="w"> </span>--check
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>If the command reports <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">migration.recompile_required</span></code>, compile the original source to produce the complete schema-v7 boundary inventory.</p>
<p>Migration operates on serialized plain data and does not reparse, reprepare, rerun NLP, or replan. Earlier steps fail safely when token ownership/spans or authored pause semantics cannot be verified without guessing. V5-to-v6 never fabricates missing source text; v6-to-v7 returns <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">migration.recompile_required</span></code> rather than inventing boundaries. Recompile the original source as a separate operation. Normal <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.load()</span></code> and plan-inspection commands reject JSON.</p>
</section>
<section id="planning-defaults">
<h2>Planning defaults</h2>
<p>Text preparation defaults to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">auto</span></code>: plain text resolves to TTSReady/Spokenform <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">spokenform</span></code>, while SSMD resolves to authoritative <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ssmd</span></code> preparation that applies reviewed <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sub</span></code> aliases without another Spokenform pass. Explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--text-preparation</span> <span class="pre">spokenform</span></code> on SSMD is a warned legacy mode; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ssmd</span></code> can also be selected explicitly, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">identity</span></code> preserves literal behavior. Applied <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sub</span></code> aliases become segment text and are recorded as compact replacements, not executable substitution directives. Newly compiled v7 plans record the resolved preparation mode in informational <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">producer.text_preparation</span></code> metadata. There is no compile-time pause activation policy, and spaCy policy is best-effort <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">auto</span></code>; installed compatible local models are preferred in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sm</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">md</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lg</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">trf</span></code> order, with deterministic fallback if unavailable. Provider documents remain internal. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--spacy</span> <span class="pre">off</span></code> to force fallback or a tier flag to require that model.</p>
<p>In Python, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PlannerConfig.document_format</span></code> defaults to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&quot;plain&quot;</span></code>; select <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&quot;ssmd&quot;</span></code> for SSMD source. There is no <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PauseConfig</span></code> or compile-time pause policy. The v7 plan stores authored pause directives separately from safe boundary opportunities; downstream renderers choose whether and how to realize them.</p>
</section>
<section id="consumer-contract">
<h2>Consumer contract</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.flow</span></code> is the render order. Each <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowUnit</span></code> owns its ordered <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowSegment</span></code> records; no ID join is required. A segment provides:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text</span></code>: prepared speech text for this segment.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">language</span></code>: effective language, defaulting from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.language</span></code> when omitted on the wire.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tokens</span></code>: local token views with optional lemma, POS, tag, and morphology.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">boundary_before</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">boundary_after</span></code>: safe canonical cut opportunities (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">clause</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sentence</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">paragraph</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">parenthetical</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice_change</span></code>), independent of pause realization.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_before</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_after</span></code>: authored SSMD pause intents (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">none</span></code>, strength, or exact timed break); automatic boundary opportunities are not pause intents.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">directives</span></code>: typed voice, pronunciation, prosody, emphasis, say-as, substitution, audio, and extension data.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">markers</span></code> and optional <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">heading</span></code> metadata already localized to the owning segment.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Token offsets are half-open Python-character ranges into the owning <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment.text</span></code>. Do not use them to slice document text or add offsets from another segment. Consumers preserve stored segment order but decide downstream chunk boundaries; a segment is not necessarily one TTS call.
Token <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pos</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tag</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lemma</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">morph</span></code> describe that exact prepared text and are the authoritative linguistic context, not model-token IDs or counts. Consumers may pass them through without retokenizing or rerunning spaCy. Optional replacements are provenance only: their output spans are segment-local, source values are original spellings, and they do not alter hashes independently of the source digest and are not synthesis inputs.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">utterplan</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">FlowPlan</span>

<span class="n">plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">FlowPlan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">load</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;chapter.utterplan.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">validate</span><span class="p">()</span>

<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">unit</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">flow</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">segment</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">unit</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">segments</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">token_views</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
            <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">token</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">start</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">token</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">end</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">token</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lemma</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">token</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">pos</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">token</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tag</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">token</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">morph</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">token</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">segment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tokens</span>
        <span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="n">render_speech</span><span class="p">(</span>
            <span class="n">text</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">segment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">segment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">language</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">tokens</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">token_views</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">pause_before</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">segment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">pause_before</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">pause_after</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">segment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">pause_after</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="n">directives</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">segment</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">directives</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="preview-consumer-chunks">
<h2>Preview consumer chunks</h2>
<p>The pure <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">preview_plan()</span></code> API groups persisted segments without changing the plan or invoking parser, planner, linguistics, G2P, or a renderer. It uses the boundary inventory already stored in the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code>; safe comma boundaries may be persisted as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">clause</span></code> opportunities. Selection is a focus over global zero-based segment indexes, and selected indexes expand to their complete containing chunks.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">utterplan</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">FlowPlan</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">preview_plan</span>

<span class="n">plan</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">FlowPlan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">load</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;chapter.utterplan.toml&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">before</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">plan_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_toml</span><span class="p">(),</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">plan_id</span>
<span class="n">chunks</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">preview_plan</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">plan</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">segments</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;58-62&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">chunk_by</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;clause&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">pause_policy</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;automatic&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">chunk</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">chunks</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">index</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">repr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">chunk</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">automatic_pause</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_toml</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">before</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">plan_id</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">plan_id</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">chunk_by</span></code> accepts <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">clause</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sentence</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">paragraph</span></code>; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_policy</span></code> accepts <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">native</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">automatic</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">manual</span></code>. Chunk text exactly concatenates stored <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment.text</span></code> and retains spaces at chunk boundaries. Automatic projection exposes saved boundary kinds, never fixed durations; manual projection keeps authored pause intent distinct. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PreviewChunk.segments</span></code> contains global/unit/local references, while tokens and replacement spans remain local to each stored segment. The CLI’s <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">preview</span> <span class="pre">--json</span></code> output is versioned for consumer tests; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--details</span></code> shows those stored local facts rather than rewriting them to fabricated chunk offsets.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.document</span></code> retains compact document information such as format, title, SSMD version, and portable semantics. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.linguistics</span></code> identifies analysis provider/model provenance without retaining provider state. Compact replacement views preserve local prepared-text spans and original spellings. The optional <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.source</span></code> record (introduced in v6 and retained in v7) retains exact raw input once (and may be absent on migrated v5 plans). Source offsets, complete preparation mappings, compiler diagnostics, and renderability details still require an optional trace sidecar.</p>
</section>
<section id="optional-compiler-trace">
<h2>Optional compiler trace</h2>
<p>When source-level evidence must survive a process boundary, request a separate trace sidecar:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>utterplan<span class="w"> </span>compile<span class="w"> </span>chapter.ssmd.md<span class="w"> </span>-o<span class="w"> </span>chapter.utterplan.toml<span class="w"> </span>--trace<span class="w"> </span>chapter.trace.toml
utterplan<span class="w"> </span>explain<span class="w"> </span>chapter.utterplan.toml<span class="w"> </span>--trace<span class="w"> </span>chapter.trace.toml
utterplan<span class="w"> </span>inspect-trace<span class="w"> </span>chapter.trace.toml<span class="w"> </span>--preparation<span class="w"> </span>--boundaries
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The trace contains source text/hash, structural/prepared text, full coordinate maps, preparation changes, diagnostics, and renderability evidence. Exact raw input is stored in the optional v7 <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.source</span></code> record; compact replacement views are available in v7 segments, while the trace remains necessary for original source offsets and complete mappings. The trace is not renderer input, does not affect <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.plan_id</span></code>, and does not change the executable plan.</p>
</section>
<section id="directives-and-media">
<h2>Directives and media</h2>
<p>Voice bindings and directive voice references are logical names, not backend voice IDs; consumers translate them to engine-specific resources. UtterPlan resolves SSMD scopes and defaults but does not choose engine settings or realize downstream pause policy; consumers interpret saved boundary and authored-pause facts.</p>
<p>An audio directive is already attached to its owning segment. Its <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">src</span></code> is opaque data for an external resolver; UtterPlan does not select or invoke one. For an audio-bearing segment, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment.text</span></code> is an optional spoken fallback. Identical source URIs on distinct segments are separate timeline occurrences and must not be deduplicated as playback events. Extension references are also data only; UtterPlan does not execute handlers.</p>
</section>
<section id="stable-renderer-input">
<h2>Stable renderer input</h2>
<p>A completed plan is immutable consumer input. Consumers may derive data for G2P/rendering, but must not rewrite planning decisions or mutate the plan:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">before</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_toml</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">plan_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">plan_id</span>
<span class="n">consume_plan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">plan</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_toml</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">before</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">plan</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">plan_id</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">plan_id</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Plans contain no phonemes, model token IDs, model sessions, audio, renderer configuration, or model-derived timings. Acoustic retries and renderer-level randomness remain outside UtterPlan.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
